visual_prompt: A sleek cart interface. The user adds a primary item into the cart. Instantly, the agent analyzes the item, pulls two high-margin complementary SKUs from a database, and visually constructs a glowing, limited-time bundle offer right below the checkout button.
A visualization of a vector space showing how the agent groups complementary products semantically.
An interactive calculator demonstrating the impact of dynamic bundles on the store's overall profit margin.
An interactive recommendation matrix with emoji SVG badges (🛒 Cart, ✨ AI Sparkle, ☕ Espresso, 🥛 Frother, 🎁 Discount Bundle, 💰 Revenue Surge), demonstrating margin gains in real time.
